from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile

root = Path('products/distribution/catalogue-editor-example-placement')
handoff = root / 'release-owner-handoff'
preview = root / 'director-buyer-preview/index-preview.html'
expected = {
    'index.html': (preview, 'c51c52bccd913d808ece4a7dec4d0a0bb13fbfd0c0ca201f30a9fd7eb62c0ab7'),
    'llms.txt': (handoff / 'served-llms.txt', 'a54969cb2775d41525fefd7c49d9d2af13c4e069b1561bce3456082ed8de90f9'),
    'transform.py': (handoff / 'served-transform.py.txt', 'ab5a7018ece8b84c442492289fb252cedb2189085042d4d9084afb21947c539e'),
    'verify.py': (handoff / 'served-verify.py.txt', '54d4d53e8656fdb7e7e7416477247039a584469520f2078b095bcdb915ae4d39'),
    'verify_example.py': (handoff / 'served-verify_example.py.txt', 'e7d92cc23e2f181a590a301b96e178511d94f44626eb58252a041428962f0b30'),
    'fixtures/before-variants.csv': (handoff / 'served-before-variants.csv', '5122a95f5611807b028ea7148a27ffc1f2f5459f89c0c8b071d163f2ef975eac'),
    'fixtures/before-images.csv': (handoff / 'served-before-images.csv', '894a95cd61cc49b7957e3faa260864649c1bdb34b6e28f8acfef9414e88f5f0d'),
    'fixtures/after-shopify.csv': (handoff / 'served-after-shopify.csv', '31c574420ea3293818aed268f0464209164c9c2c4933051078563c9098483357'),
    '7c2e9a41d86b35f0e1a4c97d2b58e360.txt': (handoff / 'served-ownership.txt', '4bd6207947cafa1135c94294aa859f204bd56c9b1b8f19297572e9ee8c686eba'),
}
manifest = {}
execution = None
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
    candidate = Path(directory)
    for name, (source, digest) in expected.items():
        actual = hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if source.is_file() else None
        manifest[name] = {'source': str(source), 'sha256': actual, 'expected_sha256': digest, 'matches': actual == digest}
        if actual == digest:
            target = candidate / name
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copyfile(source, target)
    if all(item['matches'] for item in manifest.values()):
        command = [sys.executable, 'verify_example.py', 'fixtures/before-variants.csv', 'fixtures/before-images.csv', 'fixtures/after-shopify.csv']
        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=candidate, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
        execution = {'arguments': command[1:], 'exit_code': result.returncode, 'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr}
receipt = {'inventory': manifest, 'execution': execution, 'scope': 'Isolated offline candidate assembled from the staged homepage and captured downloads. Synthetic verification only.'}
output = handoff / 'isolated-release-receipt.json'
output.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
